root.label: US delivers two F-16V fighter jets to Taiwan

events.label: US delivers two F-16V fighter jets to Taiwan

slots.name: jets delivered
slots.sentence: Two new F-16V Block 70 fighter jets landed in Taiwan on Friday, the first of a batch of 66 US-made planes ordered back in 2019 as the island nation looks to bolster its defenses in the face of threats posed by neighboring China.

slots.name: deal value
slots.sentence: The aircraft, built by US defence contractor Lockheed Martin, are part of an $8bn deal for 66 F-16Vs approved during President Donald Trump’s first term.

slots.name: deal aircraft
slots.sentence: The aircraft, built by US defence contractor Lockheed Martin, are part of an $8bn deal for 66 F-16Vs approved during President Donald Trump’s first term.

slots.name: sale value
slots.sentence: The jets, made by US defense contractor Lockheed Martin as part of an $8 billion sale agreed seven years ago, are equipped with advanced avionics, and radar systems to better counter the Chinese air force, including its stealthy J-20 fighters — but Washington has been unwilling to provide its most advanced fighters like the F-22 or F-35.

slots.name: backlog value
slots.sentence: The shipment is the first in a long list of backlogged U.S. orders worth almost $30 billion.

slots.name: F-16V value
slots.sentence: The F-16Vs represent $8 billion, or roughly 25% of the entire backlog, according to Taiwan Security Monitor at George Mason University.

slots.name: arrival date
slots.sentence: They landed on Friday following months of delay due to repeated requests from Beijing to the US to stop arming Taiwan.

slots.name: arrival time
slots.sentence: The jets, which flew via Hawaii and Guam, touched down at noon (04:00 GMT) local time.

slots.name: arrival location
slots.sentence: The aircraft, which flew via Hawaii and Guam, touched down at Chihhang Air Base near Taitung on Taiwan's mountainous east coast at midday local time (0400 GMT).
